description: This source file defines a utility function for setting up supported media capabilities (caps) in a GStreamer element class, based on a list of MIME types. It maps MIME types to GStreamer caps strings, avoids duplicate caps, and adds a sink pad template to the element class.

methods.name: rialto_mse_sink_setup_supported_caps
methods.description: Sets up supported capabilities (caps) for a GStreamer element class based on provided MIME types, mapping them to GStreamer caps strings, avoiding duplicates, and creating a sink pad template.
